title: Average Directional Index
description: Indicator measuring trend strength on a 0–100 scale, derived from smoothed directional movement and used to separate trending markets from ranging ones.

title: Double Exponential Moving Average
description: A faster, lag-reduced moving average defined as 2·EMA − EMA(EMA), designed to track price more closely than a standard EMA.

title: Exponential Moving Average
description: Moving average that applies exponentially decaying weights to past prices, making the line more responsive to recent moves than a simple SMA.

title: Relative Strength Index
description: Momentum oscillator bounded between 0 and 100 that measures the speed and magnitude of recent price changes to flag overbought and oversold conditions.

title: Simple Moving Average
description: Arithmetic mean of an asset's closing prices over a fixed look-back window, smoothing short-term noise to expose the underlying trend.

title: Standard Deviation
description: Rolling measure of price dispersion around its mean over a fixed window, used as a fundamental gauge of volatility for the requested asset and timeframe.

title: Triple Exponential Moving Average
description: A further lag-reduced moving average defined as 3·EMA − 3·EMA(EMA) + EMA(EMA(EMA)), tighter to price than both EMA and DEMA.

title: Weighted Moving Average
description: Moving average that assigns linearly decreasing weights to older prices, balancing the responsiveness of an EMA with a deterministic decay.

title: Williams
description: Momentum oscillator bounded between -100 and 0 that locates the current close relative to the highest high and lowest low of the look-back window.

title: Point in time Ratings by Analyst
description: Point-in-time summary of a single analyst's ratings as of a chosen date. Queries all of the analyst's ratings from that date and prior, returning one row per symbol they cover with their latest active call, the attached price target, and per-row statistics (analystRank, stockSuccessRate, stockAvgReturn). Targets are FX-converted by default (nonadjusted=true for native currency).

title: Point in time Ratings by Symbol
description: Point-in-time summary of a symbol's analyst ratings as of a chosen date. Queries all ratings on the ticker from that date and prior, collapsing the history to each analyst's latest active call (one row per expertUID) and surfacing per-analyst statistics — analystRank, stockSuccessRate and stockAvgReturn — alongside the price target. Price targets are FX-converted by default (nonadjusted=true for native currency).

title: Analyst Ratings Search
description: Full TipRanks analyst ratings search. Returns each individual analyst rating sourced from TipRanks, including the specific recommendation and price target from a given analyst, the action taken, the originating article/source, the price target currency (converted by default, native when nonadjusted=true), and the analyst's identity (name, firm, expertUID). Filterable by symbol, expertUID and recommendation date range, ordered newest first.

title: Ratings Summary by Analyst
description: Aggregated rollup of every recommendation a single analyst (expertUID) has issued over a date window. Returns one row with totalRecommendations plus distinctSymbols covered, a recommendation breakdown (buy/hold/sell) and analyst-action breakdown (initiated/maintained/upgraded/downgraded/reiterated/resumed). Also includes the analyst's price-target track record: validPriceTargets and comparedPriceTargets counts, beats vs misses, and return metrics (averageReturn, topReturn, worstReturn). Window defaults to the trailing twelve months.

title: Ratings Summary by Firm
description: Aggregated rollup of all ratings issued by analysts at a given firm over a date window. Pools the whole desk into one row with totalRecommendations plus distinctAnalysts and distinctSymbols, a recommendation breakdown (buy/hold/sell) and analyst-action breakdown (initiated/maintained/upgraded/downgraded/reiterated/resumed). Also includes desk-wide price-target accuracy: validPriceTargets and comparedPriceTargets counts, beats vs misses, and return metrics (averageReturn, topReturn, worstReturn). firmName must match the data exactly (e.g. 'Morgan Stanley'). Window defaults to the trailing twelve months.

title: Ratings Summary by Symbol
description: Aggregated rollup of all TipRanks ratings on a single ticker over a date window. Returns one row with totalRecommendations plus distinctAnalysts covering the name, a recommendation breakdown (buy/hold/sell) and analyst-action breakdown (initiated/maintained/upgraded/downgraded/reiterated/resumed). Also includes price-target accuracy stats: validPriceTargets and comparedPriceTargets counts, beats vs misses, and return metrics (averageReturn, topReturn, worstReturn). Window defaults to the trailing twelve months.

title: Analyst Directory Lookup
description: Analyst directory lookup by name. Resolves a TipRanks analyst profile, returning the stable expertUID used by the other TipRanks endpoints, the analyst's firm and profile image, star rating (numOfStars), and aggregate performance metrics (successRate, excessReturn, totalRecommendations, goodRecommendations). No fuzzy matching — analystName must be passed exactly as published.
